title: MC23s Modpack
description: The QoL pack for lower-end pcs and laptops!
body:
# 💻 MC23s Modpack!

### 👋 Hi there!
This is a modpack made to make your Minecraft experience better but still lightweight so lower-end pcs and laptops can run it.

By a better experience I dont mean stuff like adding physics or somthing like the create mod.
Instead it's made for vanilla with just adding stuff like friends, the ability to join others worlds (like on bedrock), building tools, optimization and some other QoL (quality of life) changes.


<details>
<summary>Features 🕹️</summary>

### Mods:
  
- Axiom - Very nice building tools.
- Reese's sodium options - Makes the video settings look nice.
- Sodium - Optimization.
- Very many players - Optimization.
- Lithuim - Optimization.
- Mod menu - Just like the name, adds a mod menu.
- Text placeholder api - Library ish.
- Malilib - Library for Litematica.
- Worldedit - Like axiom adds some nice building tools.
- Longer chat history - Like the name, makes the chat history longer.
- Iris shaders - Shader support for fabric.
- Entity Model Features (EMF) - Adds support for OptiFine's Custom Entity Models (CEM).
- Chat heads - Makes little heads of players show up in chat.
- Status - Adds a status menu where you can change your status for other players.
- Simple voice chat - Proximity chat for minecraft.
- FerriteCore - Optimization.
- Sodium extra - Extra QoL settings.
- Fabric Language Kotlin - Enables usage of the Kotlin programming language for Fabric mods.
- Entity Texture Features (ETF) - Adds many Entity Texture Features, including entity and player skin features.
- Cloth Config API - Adds a config screen api.
- Litematica - Adds features like schematics, material list and other stuff to help build up creative designs in survival.
- World Play Time - Shows you the play time of your singleplayer worlds.
- Mouse tweaks - Changes some mouse mechanics.
- Presence footsteps - '..An Overly complicated Sound Mod...'.
- Xaero's worldmap/minimap - A nice world and mini map with waypoints.
- Immediately Fast - Optimization + some other technical features.
- Viafabricplus - Makes u able to join any servers on any versions.
- Essential Mod - Some nice features like in other games, ex. friends, social etc.
- Fabric API - Library mod for fabric.
- Capes - Makes u be able to see capes like optifine's.
- Better Block Entities (BBE) - Better optimized block entities like chests.
- Resourcify - Makes you able to download resource packs, shaderpacks, datapacks and worlds from inside the game.

### Resource Packs:

- MC23s Resource Packs - Some features for the players on MC23.'
- Default Dark Mode - Optional dark mode.
- Fast Better Grass - Grass sides.

### Shaders:

- Complemantary Shaders Reimagined (optimized)\
This shader is chosen because it is easier to run on lower-end pcs and laptops.

+ custom settings if ur using 1.1 or above


</details>


<details>
<summary>Versoning system (for nerds) 📋</summary>

**{minecraftVersion}MC23s-Modpack-[modpackVersion]-[stage].mrpack**

Modpack version:\
Uses semantic versioning: \
[MAJOR].[MINOR].[PATCH]

Stage:\
Alpha, beta or release.

**Example**:\
{1.21.11}MC23s-Modpack-1.0.0-Beta.mrpack

</details>

Rebrand coming in near future.
